scope:
Independent same-input obliquity/declination observation, not a test run.

Freeze common TT and source ray, then use original Swiss ECL_NUT/cotrans
and ERFA spherical rotation. Does not certify original-source ephemeris or
out-of-bounds interpretation/physical annual solar extrema.
criterion: same-TT source obliquity/declination .001arcsec; boolean equals strict abs(dec)>abs(epsilon); no physical or author-rule certification

cone_reference.scope:
Independent FLINT/Arb cone comparisons, without importing FateBridge.

Common source coordinates/epsilon are frozen inputs. Arb encloses the
unrounded equatorial z and sin(epsilon) at 384 bits. Exact zero-latitude and
cardinal cone identities resolve only analytic equality, not a tolerance.
cone_reference.criterion: Exact strict cone predicate on supplied IEEE degree inputs; equality is in bounds, no epsilon/deadband
